section.content: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and big data, in particular to an artificial intelligence model machine learning method and a server. The artificial intelligent model machine learning method and the server specifically comprise the following steps: s1, starting; abstracting to generate a learning problem, and establishing a learning target of an artificial intelligent model machine; s2, acquiring big data, acquiring wide data resources from an external resource library, and inputting the acquired data into a system; by adopting the method in model diagnosis, the basic tuning thought of over-fitting and under-fitting is to increase the data quantity, the basic tuning thought of under-fitting is to improve the diagnosis mode of combining the characteristic quantity and the quality, and the thought of deviation in the learning direction of the artificial intelligent machine can be corrected in time, so that the bias learning of the artificial intelligent machine to the main attack data direction is carried out, unnecessary learning of the artificial intelligent machine is reduced, and the learning effect of the artificial intelligent machine is improved.

本发明涉及人工智能及大数据技术领域，尤其涉及一种人工智能模型机器学习方法及服务器。所述人工智能模型机器学习方法及服务器的具体步骤如下：步骤S1、开始；抽象生成学习问题，确立人工智能模型机器的学习目标；步骤S2、大数据获取，从外部资源库中获取广泛的数据资源，并将获取的数据录入系统中；通过在模型诊断中采用，过拟合和欠拟合的判断基本调优思路是增加数据量，欠拟合的基本调优思路是提高特征数量和质量两者的结合的诊断方式，可对人工智能机器学习方向中偏差的思路及时纠正，使人工智能机器向主攻数据方向进行偏重学习减少人工智能机器的不必要学习，提高人工智能机器的学习效果。

Artificial intelligence model machine learning method and serverTechnical Field

The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and big data, in particular to an artificial intelligence model machine learning method and a server.

Background

With the rapid development of computer technology, artificial intelligence technology has been applied in many fields, in which machine learning (mach learning) and deep learning (deep learning) have also made significant breakthroughs as the technology cores of artificial intelligence, and machines are given powerful cognitive and predictive capabilities. Machine learning and deep learning require model training using a large amount of collected sample data to facilitate later applications.

In the fields of digital finance, electronic commerce platforms and the like, in the process of data acquisition, the problems that model training fails or the application effect of a trained model in the later stage is poor and the like are very easy to cause due to factors such as insufficient data acquisition accuracy or acquisition errors of data features and the like.

Therefore, it is necessary to provide a new artificial intelligence model machine learning method and a server, so that the artificial intelligence machine performs bias learning towards the main attack data direction, unnecessary learning of the artificial intelligence machine is reduced, the learning effect of the artificial intelligence machine is improved, and the technical problems are solved.

Disclosure of Invention

In order to solve the technical problems, the application provides an artificial intelligent model machine learning method and a server.

The first aspect of the embodiment of the application discloses an artificial intelligent model machine learning method and a server: the artificial intelligent model machine learning method comprises the following specific steps:

s1, starting; abstracting to generate a learning problem, and establishing a learning target of an artificial intelligent model machine;

s2, acquiring big data, acquiring wide data resources from an external resource library, and inputting the acquired data into a system;

s3, preprocessing and selecting the characteristics, screening out the obvious characteristics and discarding the non-obvious characteristics;

s4, starting model training, wherein the model training is mainly divided into a training set, a verification set and a test set;

s5, diagnosing the generated model, and correcting and modifying the found problems in time through diagnosing the debugged model;

s6, fusing the models;

s7, detecting the online operation of the model, detecting the learning result of the artificial intelligent model machine, and judging whether the artificial intelligent model machine can perform online operation or not; and (5) ending.

Preferably, the abstract generating learning problem in step S1 is to determine to obtain the target data type according to the setting of the learning problem.

Preferably, the starting model training in step S4 includes a training set, a verification set and a test set: the training set is used for training a model and determining parameters; the validation set: the super parameters are used for determining the network structure and adjusting the model; the test set: for testing the generalization ability of the model.

Preferably, the model fusion in the step S6 is implemented by directly voting or averaging the results of each different model prediction without changing the model.

Preferably, in the step S7, the online running detection of the model is used for finding a program problem, and the running condition of the tested program is analyzed or tracking comparison is performed through the corresponding input and output relation of the effective test case.

A server comprising a processor, a memory, a data acquisition end and a learning module, the processor, memory and data acquisition end being interconnected, wherein the memory is for storing a computer program comprising a learning module, the processor being configured to invoke the learning module to perform the method of any of claims 1-5.

Compared with the related art, the artificial intelligent model machine learning method and the server provided by the application have the following beneficial effects:

the application adopts the method in model diagnosis, the basic tuning thought of over-fitting and under-fitting is to increase the data quantity, the basic tuning thought of under-fitting is to improve the diagnosis mode of combining the characteristic quantity and the quality, and the thought of deviation in the learning direction of the artificial intelligent machine can be corrected in time, so that the artificial intelligent machine carries out bias learning towards the main attack data direction, unnecessary learning of the artificial intelligent machine is reduced, and the learning effect of the artificial intelligent machine is improved.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present application more apparent, the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present application will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present application, and it is apparent that the described embodiments are some embodiments of the present application, but not all embodiments of the present application. The components of the embodiments of the present application generally described and illustrated in the figures herein may be arranged and designed in a wide variety of different configurations.

Thus, the following detailed description of the embodiments of the application, as presented in the figures, is not intended to limit the scope of the application, as claimed, but is merely representative of selected embodiments of the application. All other embodiments, which can be made by those skilled in the art based on the embodiments of the application without making any inventive effort, are intended to be within the scope of the application.

It should be noted that: like reference numerals and letters denote like items in the following figures, and thus once an item is defined in one figure, no further definition or explanation thereof is necessary in the following figures.

In the description of the embodiments of the present application, it should be noted that, if the terms "center", "upper", "lower", "left", "right", "vertical", "horizontal", "inner", "outer", etc. indicate an azimuth or a positional relationship based on that shown in the drawings, or an azimuth or a positional relationship in which the product of the present application is conventionally put when used, it is merely for convenience of describing the present application and simplifying the description, and it does not indicate or imply that the apparatus or element to be referred to must have a specific azimuth, be configured and operated in a specific azimuth, and thus should not be construed as limiting the present application. Furthermore, the terms "first," "second," "third," and the like, if any, are used merely for distinguishing between descriptions and not for indicating or implying a relative importance.

Furthermore, the terms "horizontal," "vertical," "overhang" and the like, if any, do not denote a requirement that the component be absolutely horizontal or overhang, but rather may be slightly inclined. As "horizontal" merely means that its direction is more horizontal than "vertical", and does not mean that the structure must be perfectly horizontal, but may be slightly inclined.

In the description of the embodiments of the present application, it should also be noted that, unless explicitly specified and limited otherwise, the terms "disposed," "mounted," "connected," and "connected" should be construed broadly, and may be, for example, fixedly connected, detachably connected, or integrally connected; can be mechanically or electrically connected; can be directly connected or indirectly connected through an intermediate medium, and can be communication between two elements. The specific meaning of the above terms in the present application can be understood by those of ordinary skill in the art according to the specific circumstances.

Specific implementations of the application are described in detail below in connection with specific embodiments.

Referring to fig. 1 to 3, an artificial intelligence model machine learning method and a server provided in an embodiment of the application specifically include the following steps:

s1, starting; abstracting to generate a learning problem, and establishing a learning target of an artificial intelligent model machine;

s2, acquiring big data, acquiring wide data resources from an external resource library, and inputting the acquired data into a system;

s3, preprocessing and selecting the characteristics, screening out the obvious characteristics and discarding the non-obvious characteristics;

s4, starting model training, wherein the model training is mainly divided into a training set, a verification set and a test set;

s5, diagnosing the generated model, and correcting and modifying the found problems in time through diagnosing the debugged model;

s6, fusing the models;

s7, detecting the online operation of the model, detecting the learning result of the artificial intelligent model machine, and judging whether the artificial intelligent model machine can perform online operation or not; and (5) ending.

In the embodiment of the application, the abstract generation learning problem in the step S1 is to determine the obtained target data type according to the setting of the learning problem, so that unnecessary messy learning can be avoided, the time cost of messy trial learning is reduced, and the learning effect of an artificial intelligent model machine is further facilitated;

the abstract generation learning problem can clearly know what data is obtained, and the problem that the target is classification, regression or clustering is solved, so that the later artificial intelligent model machine learning target can be conveniently established.

In the embodiment of the application, the upper limit of the machine learning result of the big data acquisition artificial intelligent model is the volume of the data, the algorithm only approaches the upper limit as far as possible, the acquired data is representative and cannot overlap seriously, the magnitude of the data is estimated, and the number of samples and the number of characteristics are estimated, for example, the indexes such as the peak value of the access quantity application server of the system, the database, the cache and the message queue requested every second, the request response time and the like are accessed from the application server, and the consumption degree of the memory can be conveniently estimated by the indexes, so that whether the memory can be put down in the training process is judged.

In the embodiment of the application, the preprocessing and selection of the features, the preprocessing of the features and the data arrangement can obviously improve the effect and performance of the algorithm. The basic essential steps of machine learning such as normalization, discretization, factorization, missing value processing, collinearity removal and the like are that significant features are screened out, non-significant features are abandoned, and a machine learning engineer is required to repeatedly understand the service to have decisive influence on the result;

the method has the advantages that the characteristics are well selected, the difficulty of the algorithm can be reduced, meanwhile, good and stable results can be obtained, and the methods of correlation coefficient, chi-square test, average mutual information, conditional entropy, posterior probability, logistic regression weight and the like can be applied through the correlation technology of characteristic effectiveness analysis.

In an embodiment of the present application, the starting model training in step S4 includes a training set, a validation set, and a test set: the training set is used for training a model and determining parameters; the validation set: the super parameters are used for determining the network structure and adjusting the model; the test set: for testing the generalization ability of the model.

The result becomes better by adjusting the super parameter of the algorithm, and the symptom of the problem can be found and modified in the debugging process, so that a good optimization scheme is provided.

In the embodiment of the application, when the generated model is diagnosed, the over-fitting and under-fitting judgment is the critical one-step model diagnosis in the model diagnosis, methods such as cross validation, drawing a learning curve and the like can be used, if a one-step method is adopted, m samples are divided into m subsets, only one sample is taken each time as a test set, and the rest are all training sets, and because only one sample is taken each time by the one-step method, each training model is very close to the model to be evaluated, and therefore, the model is considered to be more accurate;

the basic tuning thought of the over-fitting is to increase the data quantity, reduce the complexity of the model, for example, continuously acquire new data, for increasing the data quantity, so that the red line simulated in the later stage can be straightened slowly and become less distorted, the basic tuning thought of the under-fitting is to improve the feature quantity and quality, for example, the enterprise first carries out comprehensive screening on metadata, carries out classification extraction according to different features, acquires more feature quantity data, improves the quality of the feature quantity, enables the artificial intelligent machine to carry out bias learning towards the main attack data direction, reduces unnecessary learning of the artificial intelligent machine, and improves the learning effect of the artificial intelligent machine;

meanwhile, error analysis is also an important step of artificial intelligent model machine learning, and the error causes are comprehensively analyzed by observing error samples, so that the error causes are parameters, algorithm selection and characteristics or data can be obtained more intuitively;

and the diagnosed model needs to be optimized, and the new model after the optimization needs to be diagnosed again, so that the optimal state is achieved through the repeated iteration continuous approximation process.

In the embodiment of the present application, the model fusion in the step S6 is implemented by directly voting or averaging the results predicted by different models without changing the model;

for example, for classification problems, assuming three independent models, each with a 70% accuracy, voting in a few majority-compliant manner, the final accuracy will be: 0.7.0.7.7+0.7.0.7.3 =0.343+0.441=0.784

I.e., the result is simply voted, which increases the accuracy by about 8%, the more models that are voted, the better the result,

the model fusion can improve the effect to a certain extent, and the method for mainly improving the accuracy of the algorithm is to finish and pretreat the characteristics of the front end of the model respectively, and the fusion of different sampling modes and the model of the rear end is performed;

because the sampling of different modes is different and can not be duplicated, through the establishment of the standard, each artificial intelligent model machine can obtain a more stable effect, and the direct parameter adjustment work can not be much, so that the phenomenon that the model fusion effect cannot be effectively ensured due to too much training effect and too much data quantity is avoided.

In the embodiment of the application, the online operation detection of the model in the step S7 is used for finding out program problems, the operation condition of the tested program is analyzed or tracking comparison is performed through the corresponding input and output relation of the effective test case, the success or failure of the model is directly determined by the online operation effect of the model, the conditions of accuracy, error and the like are not only included, and the operation speed, the time complexity, the resource consumption degree, the space complexity and the stability are acceptable;

some experiences which can be summarized by the workflow can be used for determining whether the artificial intelligent model machine finishes model learning or not through statistical analysis of all experiences, and the artificial intelligent model machine reaching a learning template can perform online operation.

A server comprising a processor, a memory, a data acquisition end and a learning module, the processor, memory and data acquisition end being interconnected, wherein the memory is for storing a computer program comprising a learning module, the processor being configured to invoke the learning module to perform the method of any of the above.

The foregoing description is only illustrative of the present application and is not intended to limit the scope of the application, and all equivalent structures or equivalent processes or direct or indirect application in other related technical fields are included in the scope of the present application.
